method.units: native image pixels, target-minus-reference, x right/y down
method.ecc: translation only; ZNCC integer initialization +/-12 px, max 200 iterations, epsilon 1e-8, Gaussian 5x5
method.phase: phase-only cross spectrum; Gaussian 5x5, subtract mean, Hann; inverse DFT local grids 0.01 and 0.001 px
method.roi: center1 white QR boxes plus 12 px, located per group using ZNCC +/-230 x and +/-20 y; fixed within each group
method.aggregation: 3 QR estimates retained individually; their arithmetic mean reports common apparent displacement

synthetic_checks.scope: Numerical sign/sensitivity checks under a Fourier-shift image model, not physical calibration.
synthetic_checks.noise: gain 1.02, offset 2 DN, Gaussian sigma 1 DN, uint8 quantization; fixed seed 20261021

limitations: Three original images per group; the three pairs are not independent repeat captures.
Capture protocol and Actual-field provenance remain unspecified.
Both methods use the same image evidence and translation model; agreement does not establish physical accuracy.
Numerical 0.001 px phase grid is not a demonstrated 0.001 px accuracy.
No Y/theta physical inversion or pass/fail tolerance is applied.
The two methods do not test affine or perspective changes.
Synthetic trials test only the stated rendering/noise model and are not physical calibration.
